# Push Requirements Checklist: Push Notifications (client)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of spec 017 — privacy of the push token and payloads, the registration lifecycle, the Firebase isolation and approval boundary, tap routing safety, preferences concurrency, permission timing, and backend contract fidelity
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Focus (assumed default, owner away): privacy and the dependency boundary first, then lifecycle and routing correctness, then preferences, UX completeness and contract fidelity; standard depth; audience = PR reviewer. Items found as gaps were fixed in the spec, research or contracts in the same session; each says where. `[x]` = reviewed and holds (or fixed); unchecked items are left for the PR reviewer or the live QA.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is every one of the 12 payload types mapped to a read and a target screen, with a fallback for a bad identifier? [Completeness, Spec FR-031, contracts/push-domain.md §3]
- [x] CHK002 Is the behaviour for an unknown type and a schema other than "1" specified for both display and tap? [Completeness, FR-025, FR-030]
- [x] CHK003 Is every registration trigger listed (sign-in, new token, permission allowed, daily foreground) and is "not more often" stated? [Completeness, FR-002]
- [x] CHK004 Is the sign-out order (DELETE, server sign-out, discard, clear) and its time bound specified? [Completeness, FR-007, SC-008]
- [x] CHK005 Is the remote session-end path distinguished from user sign-out (no DELETE with a dead credential)? [Completeness, FR-007, research R-07]
- [x] CHK006 Is what the owner must approve and supply listed concretely (artifacts, plugin, file paths per flavor, Firebase project, application id)? [Completeness, Assumptions "Owner must approve or supply", plan Complexity Tracking]
- [x] CHK007 Is the behaviour of staging/production builds before the Firebase phase specified (no row, no sheet, no request, no registration)? [Completeness, FR-046, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK008 Is the "Opening…" Cancel defined, including what happens to the read still running? [Gap → fixed: FR-032 "the read may finish in the background; nothing opens afterwards"]
- [x] CHK009 Is the explanation sheet's behaviour defined when another sheet or dialog is already showing? [Gap → fixed: FR-011 "not shown and not counted as offered"]
- [x] CHK010 Is the time-zone note defined when the profile is not on the phone yet? [Gap → fixed: FR-015 "omitted while the profile is not on the phone yet"]
- [x] CHK011 Is display below Android 8 (no channels) specified? [Gap → fixed: FR-022]
- [x] CHK012 Is a tap while the blocking "update required" screen shows specified? [Gap → fixed: FR-033, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 Is the Room decision explicit? [Completeness, Spec §3 "no Room change (stays v10)", plan Storage]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK014 Is "at most daily" defined as a testable rule (same session, same token fingerprint, < 24 h, foreground trigger only)? [Clarity, FR-002, research R-04]
- [x] CHK015 Is the `404` handling bounded (one re-read, one retry, no sign-out, stop marker cleared by sign-in or new token)? [Clarity, FR-005, data-model §4]
- [x] CHK016 Is "in context" for the permission precise (three moments, once per installation, "Not now" final)? [Clarity, FR-010, FR-011]
- [x] CHK017 Is the conflict resolution precise (the answer's `current` replaces the edits; its version becomes the last-read one)? [Clarity, FR-018]
- [x] CHK018 Are quarter hours, 24-hour form, Western digits and LTR stated for times? [Clarity, FR-016, research R-13]
- [x] CHK019 Is the collapse key per type stated and identical to the backend table? [Clarity, contracts/push-domain.md §2 vs backend push-api.md]
- [x] CHK020 Is the 10-second "Opening…" bound measured from the tap or from the screen showing? [Clarity, Gap → fixed in analyze: FR-032 "counted from when that screen starts its read"]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK021 Do spec FR-031, contracts/push-domain.md §3 and data-model `PushTarget` list the same targets? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK022 Does "record already on the phone opens at once" (FR-032) agree with SC-003 and US2-10? [Consistency — fixed in the spec validation pass]
- [x] CHK023 Do the sign-out bounds in FR-007 and SC-008 agree (existing 5 s + 2 s)? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK024 Does the spec's "tap only navigates" agree with routing reads (reads are allowed, writes never)? [Consistency, FR-029, contracts/push-domain.md rule 2]
- [x] CHK025 Is the export target consistent with spec 016's keys, and is the fallback while 016 is unmerged stated? [Consistency, Assumptions design default 15, research R-03]

## Privacy & Security

- [x] CHK026 Is it specified that the token is never stored by the app (fingerprint only) and never logged or shown? [Privacy, FR-004, FR-008, invariant §4]
- [x] CHK027 Is the lock-screen behaviour specified for both foreground-posted and system-displayed messages? [Privacy, FR-022 channel private, FR-023 public version; Backend gap 2]
- [x] CHK028 Are launcher-intent extras treated as untrusted with validation rules? [Security, FR-030, FR-044, research R-10]
- [x] CHK029 Is clearing at sign-out complete (shade, de-dup list, registration record, scheduled jobs, token)? [Privacy, FR-043, research R-07]
- [x] CHK030 Is the invitation token kept out of push and out of the notice screen? [Privacy, FR-034]
- [x] CHK031 Is the app forbidden from composing notification text from records (names, amounts, dates)? [Privacy, FR-028]
- [x] CHK032 Is Firebase confined to one module, with a failing test otherwise? [Boundary, FR-045, contracts/push-domain.md §1]

## Scenario & Edge Coverage

- [x] CHK033 Are shared-phone / account-switch scenarios covered? [Edge Cases "Two people share a phone"]
- [x] CHK034 Is an offline sign-out covered (server session lives on)? [Edge Cases "Sign-out offline", clarification 5]
- [x] CHK035 Are revoked permission and blocked single channel distinguished? [Edge Cases, FR-006]
- [x] CHK036 Are records gone since the push (wallet left, budget deleted, export expired, deletion cancelled) covered by the target screens' existing states? [Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK037 Are rate limits covered for both endpoints (20/h registration, 30/h preferences)? [FR-003, FR-018, Edge Cases]

## Contract Fidelity

- [x] CHK038 Are request bodies exactly the schema's members (no platform, version or language on register; no `updated_at` on save)? [FR-039, contracts/push-api-client.md]
- [x] CHK039 Is every documented answer of the four operations mapped to an outcome? [contracts/push-api-client.md outcome table]
- [ ] CHK040 Does the uncommitted `notifications.yaml` still match after backend spec 023 is committed? [Dependency, T001 — rerun the contract check before coding and before live QA]
- [x] CHK041 Are the backend's own client-behaviour notes honoured or deliberately varied with a reason (daily re-register instead of every start; DELETE also when the OS turns notifications off)? [Assumptions design defaults 7–8]

## Testability & Acceptance

- [x] CHK042 Can every story be verified on the host with a fake provider (no device)? [SC-009, spec §8, research R-17]
- [x] CHK043 Are device-only checks (real FCM delivery, lock screen, system dialog) named and deferred to the owner? [quickstart §3–4, contracts/ui-and-e2e.md §10]
- [ ] CHK044 Is the Robolectric fidelity of `NotificationManager` (tags, public version, channel visibility) sufficient, or does any assertion need a device? [Testability — decide at implementation; device spot check listed in quickstart §3]
